core: CD4 helper T cell lineage commitment
qualifier: IL-12-driven Th1 polarization
name: IL-12-driven Th1 polarization of CD4 helper lineage
rationale: Members cover CD4 helper fate choice centred on Th1 differentiation, IL-12/JAK-STAT input and IFN-gamma production (with Treg and Th17 restraint), whereas confusables emphasise IFN-gamma response signalling, dendritic/NKT cells or Treg differentiation.

qualifier: cadherin genes, via DNA-binding interference
name: Cadherin gene transcription and repressor DNA-binding control
rationale: Members concern transcriptional control of CDH1, CDH11 and TGFBR3 plus general repression by blocking DNA binding and initiation, which the confusables (EMT adhesion, mesenchymal SMAD, RUNX3/FOXO targets) lack.

qualifier: tachykinin and GnRH, in reproductive function
name: Tachykinin and GnRH PLC-calcium signalling in reproduction
rationale: Members combine tachykinin and GnRH receptor signalling through PLC, IP3 and calcium with male mating, erection, insemination and parturition, unlike confusables centred on visceral smooth muscle contraction or cAMP-coupled signalling.

qualifier: ventricular wall growth, hypertrophy and regeneration
name: Cardiomyocyte proliferation, myocardial wall growth and regeneration
rationale: Members regulate cardiomyocyte proliferation, differentiation, survival and growth building compact/trabecular myocardium and in adult hypertrophy and regeneration, whereas confusables cover embryonic heart patterning, valves and septa, vasculogenesis or muscle adaptation.

qualifier: ARF/Rab GTPase-regulated Golgi ribbon dynamics and endocytic recycling
name: ARF/Rab-regulated Golgi architecture and endosomal recycling
rationale: Members cover Golgi ribbon disassembly/reassembly, COPI budding, ARF and Rab-GAP signalling and endosome tubulation/recycling, whereas confusables are dominated by Golgi-endosome-lysosome and retrograde transport routes.

qualifier: coupled to succinate oxidation at complex II and ATP synthesis
name: TCA cycle linked to succinate oxidation and ATP synthesis
rationale: Members are TCA cycle intermediates (malate, succinate, 2-oxoglutarate) plus complex II electron transport and ATP synthesis, which distinguishes them from confusables built on isocitrate/NADPH, PDH/CoA, glutamate or the malate-aspartate shuttle.

qualifier: combined T and B cell, including thymocytes
name: Combined T and B lymphocyte development signatures
rationale: All members are lymphocyte development/activation expression signatures spanning both thymocyte/T cell and B cell differentiation, whereas confusables are B-cell germinal centre, T-cell activation or thymic selection specific.

qualifier: ear, olfactory and cranial sensory nerves
name: Ear, olfactory and cranial sensory nerve development
rationale: Members build the inner, middle and outer ear, nose and olfactory nerve (with GnRH neuron migration), taste papillae and cranial sensory ganglia/nerves, unlike confusables on craniofacial skeleton, glands, hindbrain motor neurons or hair-cell fate.

qualifier: calcium-dependent
name: Calcium-dependent adherens junction assembly
rationale: All three members concern assembling adherens junctions and calcium-dependent cadherin adhesion, whereas confusables cover junction maintenance, epithelial polarity or cadherin degradation and trafficking.

qualifier: congenital disorders of glycosylation, GDP-mannose and dolichol supply
name: Dolichol-linked oligosaccharide assembly and congenital glycosylation disorders
rationale: Members are GDP-mannose, dolichol-phosphate and ALG-mediated lipid-linked oligosaccharide synthesis and their CDG defects, distinguishing them from confusables on N-glycan trimming, nucleotide-sugar transport, sialic acid or GPI anchors.

qualifier: neuronal cargo: mitochondria, dense core and synaptic vesicles
name: Microtubule transport of mitochondria and vesicles in neurons
rationale: Members are microtubule-directed transport of mitochondria, dense core vesicles, synaptic vesicles and receptors along axons and dendrites, whereas confusables emphasise kinesin/tubulin modification, microtubule severing or endolysosome size.

qualifier: CFTR and anion/water transport, membrane rafts
name: Polarized epithelial protein trafficking and CFTR-mediated anion transport
rationale: Members cover apical/basolateral sorting, raft targeting and Golgi-to-surface delivery together with CFTR trafficking and transepithelial anion and water transport, unlike confusables on TRP/K+ channels, bile lipid flippases, tight junctions or membrane scrambling.

core: Oncogenic escape from the beta-catenin destruction complex
qualifier: CTNNB1 phosphosite and AXIN missense mutants
name: Beta-catenin phosphosite and AXIN missense mutants evading destruction
rationale: All members are cancer point mutations in CTNNB1 phosphodegron residues or AXIN that block beta-catenin degradation, while confusables cover APC truncations, AXIN1 deletions or normal Wnt signalling steps.

qualifier: AU-rich element binding proteins and translational silencing
name: AU-rich element-mediated mRNA decay and translational silencing
rationale: Members are ARE-binding proteins (TTP, BRF1, KSRP, AUF1, HuR) and 3'-UTR-directed decay, stabilization and translational repression, distinguishing them from confusables on stress granules, ADAR editing or AP-1/NF-kB immediate-early programmes.

qualifier: protein refolding and mitochondrial UPR
name: HSF1 heat shock and mitochondrial unfolded protein responses
rationale: Members cover HSF1 activation and attenuation, heat acclimation and chaperone refolding plus the mitochondrial UPR, whereas confusables add protein acetylation, stress granules, FOXO signalling or ER folding.

qualifier: proline, glycine and glyoxylate
name: Proline, glycine and glyoxylate amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are generic amino and organic acid metabolism terms anchored by proline synthesis/catabolism, glycine synthesis and glyoxylate metabolism, while confusables centre on aromatic, histidine or threonine catabolism or glycine conjugation.

qualifier: GPVI-triggered
name: GPVI-triggered platelet activation and aggregation control
rationale: Members are platelet activation signatures, GPVI signalling and positive/negative aggregation control, distinct from confusables built on VWF/GPIb adhesion and degranulation or ADP, thrombin and thromboxane GPCR signalling.

qualifier: drug, hypoxia and oxidative stress
name: Modulation of cellular drug, hypoxia and oxidative-stress responses
rationale: Members regulate cellular responses to antibiotics/drugs, hypoxia and oxidative stress (with stress-linked developmental apoptosis), whereas confusables concern UV, peroxide-induced intrinsic apoptosis or responses to specific xenobiotics like ethanol and cisplatin.

qualifier: receptor-agnostic HES/HEY output
name: Canonical Notch-induced HES/HEY target gene transcription
rationale: All members describe transcriptional output of Notch on its HLH target genes, whereas confusables are NOTCH1-4 receptor-specific processing, activation, mutants or ERBB4 crosstalk.

qualifier: with HSF1 heat shock response
name: Protein acetylation and HSF1-regulated heat shock response
rationale: Members combine histone, lysine and N-terminal acetylation (and tubulin deacetylation) with HSF1 activation, attenuation and heat acclimation, which separates them from chromatin-remodelling, methylation or refolding/UPRmt confusables.

qualifier: ERAD and reticulophagy
name: Misfolded protein quality control via ERAD and reticulophagy
rationale: Members cover recognition, unfolding, ubiquitination and degradation of misfolded proteins through ERAD regulation and ER-phagy, whereas confusables emphasise aggrephagy, ribosome quality control or ubiquitin chain types.

qualifier: gonadal sex determination, genital tract and prostate
name: Gonadal sex determination and genital tract and prostate morphogenesis
rationale: Members span sex determination, gonad and Leydig/AMH signalling and morphogenesis of Mullerian tract, genitalia and prostate, unlike confusables on germ cells/Sertoli cells, pancreas or mammary gland.

qualifier: inflammatory chemokine gene clusters, NK and monocyte
name: Chemokine ligand-receptor clusters in leukocyte chemotaxis
rationale: Members are chemokine and receptor expression clusters and binding with NK chemotaxis and monocyte differentiation, whereas confusables emphasise lymphocyte/dendritic homing to lymphoid organs or CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte trafficking.

qualifier: keratinocyte migration and proliferation, IL-20 family
name: Keratinocyte migration and proliferation in wound re-epithelialization
rationale: Members promote epidermal spreading, keratinocyte migration and proliferation, ECM disassembly and resolution of wound inflammation (IL-20 family), unlike confusables on keratinocyte differentiation or negative migration and adhesion signalling.

qualifier: GPVI and GPIb-IX-V collagen/VWF receptors
name: GPVI and GPIb-IX-V-triggered platelet adhesion and activation
rationale: Members cover collagen adhesion via GPVI and GPIb-IX-V, platelet activation, degranulation, aggregation and coagulation, distinguishing them from VWF-variant, coagulation-factor-defect and ADP P2Y confusables.
